speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You've presented with fatigue and difficulty concentrating, which are concerning symptoms. To begin my assessment, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these issues and if you have noticed any changes in your weight or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: The dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold are very suggestive of Raynaud's phenomenon. Combined with your dyspnea and fatigue, do you have any known history of autoimmune disorders or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Polymyalgia Rheumatica (PMR) with Giant Cell Arteritis (GCA) suspicion.

The combination of new-onset fatigue, constitutional symptoms, and digital pain improving with cold is highly suggestive of GCA/PMR. REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, CBC. REQUEST IMAGES: Temporal_Artery_Ultrasound.
